title: Mt Kodu/Kokoda Track landowner blockade over unpaid PNG government compensation
location: Naoro/Nauro and Kokoda Track, Central Province; route length and affected section vary in accounts
public_gathering: Landowners maintained a track closure; simultaneous number physically participating is not stated.
domestic_state_demand: Payment of outstanding PNG government compensation owed to Kodu landowners for foregoing the mining project.
continuity: The National reported the track remained indefinitely closed on Nov 26; later official/broadcaster reports say it reopened Dec 5.
notes: Do not interpret crowd or attendee numbers for trekking forums, tourists, track corridor residents or government officials as blockade participants.

continuity.summary: Nov 26 article says still closed; Dec reports later describe closure and reopening.

demand.summary: Articles attribute closure to unpaid government compensation.
